Contract CoCoMESystem::openStore(storeID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		targetStore: Store = Store.allInstance()->any(s|s.Name = storeID)
	precondition:
		targetStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		targetStore.IsOpened = false
	postcondition:
		let newCurrentStore: Store in
		newCurrentStore.oclIsNew() and
		newCurrentStore = targetStore and
		newCurrentStore.IsOpened = true and
		CurrentStore = newCurrentStore and
		Store.allInstance()->includes(newCurrentStore) and
		result = true
}
